```{r}
library(msImpute)
# Let xna be a numeric matrix of (unormalised) log-intensity with NAs 
# Let "group" define a single experimental condition (e.g. control, treatment etc).
# Let "design" define the experimental design (e.g. model.matrix(~0+group+batch)).

# select peptides missing in at least one experimental group
group <- metadata_scp$group
test <- selectFeatures(xna_qn, method="ebm", group=group) 

# Impute complex MV mechanims (MNAR and MAR) as mixture of two normal distributions (known as the Barycenter approach) 
design <- model.matrix(~0+group)
xcomplete <- msImpute(xna_qn, method="v2-mnar", design=design)  
```
```{r}
calc_ari <- function(expr_mat, metadata, k = 4) {
  pca <- prcomp(t(expr_mat), scale. = TRUE)
  pca_coord <- pca$x  
  
  set.seed(123)
  km <- kmeans(pca_coord, centers = k, nstart = 50)
  
  true_label <- metadata$group
  pred_label <- km$cluster
  ari <- adjustedRandIndex(true_label, pred_label)
  
  return(ari)
}

imp_list <- list(
```

# Iteration of ARI 
```{r}
calc_metrics_subsample <- function(expr_mat, metadata, k = 4, n_iter = 20, prop = 0.8, seed = 123) {
  
  metadata_use <- metadata[colnames(expr_mat), , drop = FALSE]
  
  if (!all(colnames(expr_mat) == rownames(metadata_use))) {
    stop("metadata rownames do not match expr_mat colnames.")
  }
  
  res_list <- vector("list", length = n_iter)
  
  for (i in seq_len(n_iter)) {
    set.seed(seed + i)
    
    idx <- sample(seq_len(ncol(expr_mat)),
                  size = floor(prop * ncol(expr_mat)),
                  replace = FALSE)
    
    expr_sub <- expr_mat[, idx, drop = FALSE]
    meta_sub <- metadata_use[idx, , drop = FALSE]
    
    # PCA
    pca <- prcomp(t(expr_sub), scale. = TRUE)
    pca_coord <- pca$x
    
    # kmeans
    km <- kmeans(pca_coord, centers = k, nstart = 50)
    pred_cluster <- km$cluster
    true_label <- meta_sub$group
    
    # ARI
    ari_val <- adjustedRandIndex(true_label, pred_cluster)
    
    # NMI
    nmi_val <- NMI(as.character(true_label), as.character(pred_cluster))
    
    # Silhouette score
    dist_mat <- dist(pca_coord)
    sil <- silhouette(pred_cluster, dist_mat)
    sil_mean <- mean(sil[, "sil_width"])
    
    res_list[[i]] <- data.frame(
      Iteration = i,
      ARI = ari_val,
      NMI = nmi_val,
      Silhouette = sil_mean
    )
  }
  
  bind_rows(res_list)
}
```

```{r}
colnames(imp_list$MSImpute) <- paste0(colnames(xcomplete))
colnames(imp_list$SoftHybrid) <- paste0(colnames(df_imp_soft))

metric_results <- lapply(names(imp_list), function(m) {
  
  mat <- imp_list[[m]]
  
  res <- calc_metrics_subsample(
    expr_mat = mat,
    metadata = metadata_scp,
    k = 4,
    n_iter = 20,
    prop = 0.8,
    seed = 123
  )
  
  res$Method <- m
  res
  
}) %>% bind_rows()
```

```{r}
metric_results$Method <- factor(metric_results$Method, levels = c("MSImpute", "SoftHybrid"))

metric_results <- metric_results[,-4]

metric_long <- metric_results %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(ARI, NMI),
    names_to = "Metric",
    values_to = "Value"
  )

metric_long$Metric <- factor(metric_long$Metric, levels = c("ARI", "NMI"))

metric_summary <- metric_long %>%
  group_by(Metric, Method) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_value = mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_value = sd(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_value = median(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

metric_pvals <- metric_long %>%
  group_by(Metric) %>%
  summarise(
    p_value = wilcox.test(Value ~ Method, data = cur_data(), exact = FALSE)$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    significance = case_when(
      p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_value < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p_value < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE            ~ "ns"
    )
  )

metric_ypos <- metric_long %>%
  group_by(Metric) %>%
  summarise(
    y_max = max(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    y_min = min(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(metric_pvals, by = "Metric") %>%
  mutate(
    y_line = y_max + 0.08 * (y_max - y_min + 1e-6),
    y_text = y_max + 0.15 * (y_max - y_min + 1e-6)
  )

my_colors <- c(
  "MSImpute"   = "#E69F00",
  "SoftHybrid" = "#9966CC"
)

p_metrics <- ggplot(metric_long, aes(x = Method, y = Value, fill = Method)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, 
               outlier.shape = NA, 
               color = "black", 
               linewidth = 0.5) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    shape = 21,
    size = 2.8,
    fill = "white",
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.9
  ) +

  geom_segment(
    data = metric_ypos,
    aes(x = 1, xend = 2, y = y_line, yend = y_line),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = metric_ypos,
    aes(x = 1, xend = 1, y = y_line - 0.01, yend = y_line),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = metric_ypos,
    aes(x = 2, xend = 2, y = y_line - 0.01, yend = y_line),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = metric_ypos,
    aes(x = 1.5, y = y_text, label = significance),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 4.8,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = my_colors) +
  facet_wrap(~ Metric, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Method"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.border      = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.6),
    text              = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text         = element_text(size = 12.5, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    axis.text.x       = element_blank(),
    axis.title        = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.length.y = unit(2, "mm"),
    panel.grid.major  = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
    legend.position   = "right",
    legend.title      = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
    legend.text       = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.title        = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 15),
    strip.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
    strip.text        = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold")
  )
```

# Pearson Correlation with Ground Truth
## Function Settings
```{r}
evaluate_function <- function(imputed_mat, truth_mat, metadata) {
  result_list <- list()
  for (grp in unique(metadata$group)) {
    samples <- metadata %>% filter(group == grp) %>% pull(sample)
    common_genes <- intersect(rownames(imputed_mat), rownames(truth_mat))
    truth_vec <- truth_mat[common_genes, grp]
    expr_mat  <- imputed_mat[common_genes, samples]
    stats <- apply(expr_mat, 2, function(x) {
      list(
        RMSE     = sqrt(mean((x - truth_vec)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
        MAE      = mean(abs(x - truth_vec), na.rm = TRUE),
        Pearson  = cor(x, truth_vec, method = "pearson", use = "complete.obs"),
        Spearman = cor(x, truth_vec, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")
      )
    })
    df_stat <- bind_rows(stats, .id = "Sample") %>%
      mutate(group = grp)
    result_list[[grp]] <- df_stat
  }
  bind_rows(result_list)
}
```
## Evaluation
```{r}
df_truth <- df_bulk %>%
  mutate(gene = rownames(.)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = colnames(df_bulk), 
               names_to = "sample", 
               values_to = "intensity")
df_truth$group <- plyr::mapvalues(df_truth$sample,
                                  from = metadata_bulk$sample,
                                  to = metadata_bulk$group)
df_truth$group <- factor(df_truth$group, levels = c(1,2,3,4))
levels(df_truth$group) <- c("GSC", 'AST', "MAC", "MIC")
df_truth <- df_truth %>%
  group_by(gene, group) %>%
  summarise(
    MeanExpr   = mean(intensity, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
NA_rm <- df_truth %>%
  filter(is.na(MeanExpr)) %>%
  .$gene
NA_rm <- unique(NA_rm)
df_truth <- df_truth %>%
  filter(!gene %in% NA_rm)
test <- unique(df_truth$gene)

xcomplete_bm <- xcomplete %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  filter(rownames(.) %in% test)
df_imp_soft_bm <- df_imp_soft %>%
  filter(rownames(.) %in% test)

imp_list_bm <- list(
  MSImpute = xcomplete_bm,
  SoftHybrid = df_imp_soft_bm
)
truth_mat <- df_truth %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = MeanExpr) %>%
  column_to_rownames("gene")


result_combined <- map2_dfr(imp_list_bm, names(imp_list_bm), ~{
  df <- evaluate_function(.x, truth_mat, metadata_scp)
  df$Method <- .y
  df
})
```
## Visulisation
```{r}
method_colors <- c(
  "MSImpute"   = "#E69F00",
  "SoftHybrid" = "#9966CC"
)

plot_df <- result_combined %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample, Method, MAE, Spearman) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(MAE, Spearman),
    names_to = "Metric",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Metric = factor(Metric, levels = c("MAE", "Spearman"))
  )

mean_df <- plot_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Metric, Method) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_value = mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_value  = max(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_value  = min(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    range_value = max_value - min_value,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    y_text = max_value + ifelse(range_value == 0, 0.05, 0.08 * range_value)
  )

sig_df <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(Metric) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    tmp_wide <- .x %>%
      dplyr::select(Sample, Method, Value) %>%
      group_by(Sample, Method) %>%
      summarise(Value = mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = Method, values_from = Value) %>%
      drop_na()

    wt <- wilcox.test(
      tmp_wide$SoftHybrid,
      tmp_wide$MSImpute,
      paired = TRUE,
      alternative = "two.sided"
    )

    y_max <- max(.x$Value, na.rm = TRUE)
    y_min <- min(.x$Value, na.rm = TRUE)
    y_rng <- y_max - y_min
    y_pos <- y_max + ifelse(y_rng == 0, 0.08, 0.12 * y_rng)

    tibble(
      group1 = "MSImpute",
      group2 = "SoftHybrid",
      p = wt$p.value,
      p.signif = case_when(
        wt$p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
        wt$p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
        wt$p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ "ns"
      ),
      p.label = paste0("p = ", signif(wt$p.value, 3)),
      y.position = y_pos
    )
  }) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

plot_df$Metric <- factor(plot_df$Metric, levels = c('Spearman', 'MAE'))

p_metrics_2 <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(x = Method, y = Value, fill = Method)
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.6,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    shape = 21,
    size = 3,
    fill = "white",
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.8
  ) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(
    sig_df,
    label = "p.signif",   
    xmin = "group1",
    xmax = "group2",
    y.position = "y.position",
    tip.length = 0.01,
    bracket.size = 0.5,
    size = 5,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = method_colors) +
  facet_wrap(~Metric, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1,
             labeller = as_labeller(c(
               MAE = "AE",
               Spearman = "Spearman"
             ))) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Imputation Method",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.border      = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.6),
    text              = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text         = element_text(size = 12.5, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    axis.text.x       = element_blank(),
    axis.title        = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x      = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.length.y = unit(2, "mm"),
    panel.grid.major  = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
    legend.position   = "right",
    legend.title      = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),

    strip.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
    strip.text        = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold")
```
